title: The Percentage of Cases of Acute Treatment With Allopurinol in Gout Patients
brief_summary: The aim of the study is to determine the percentage of cases of acute treatment with Allopurinol in gout patients who have been previously treated.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Gout patients

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant women
* Chronic renal failure
* Patients with Allopurinal hypersensitivity
